facts.business: Tamilnadu Telecommunications Limited manufactures Optical Fiber Cable (OFC) but has not operated its factory since 2017 and has had no sales for over eight years.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Order booking position is expected to improve as there is huge requirement of OF cable in the near future due to the impact of 5G.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Going concern assumption not appropriate due to accumulated losses of Rs. 2,50,03,609 hundreds eroding net worth, factory not operated since 2017, no sales for over 8 years, major overhauling cost required, unable to obtain raw material supply, no new orders; financial assets/liabilities stated at historical cost instead of fair value per Ind AS 113 and Ind AS 109; amounts due to holding company TCIL not recognized at fair value per Ind AS 109; various balances subject to confirmation.

key_risks: Going concern uncertainty due to accumulated losses and eroded net worth
Factory not operational since 2017 with no sales for over 8 years
Major overhauling cost required to resume operations
Unable to obtain raw material supply from supplier
No new orders to substantiate going concern
Lease proposal for manufacturing facilities cancelled
Strategic disinvestment of promoter TCIL's stake initiated through DIPAM
Financial assets and liabilities not measured at fair value as per Ind AS
Balances subject to confirmation from parties
Dependence on government/PSU orders for revival
facts.related_party_note: Amounts due to holding company Telecommunications Consultants India Limited (TCIL) of Rs. 1,85,77,041 hundreds (Previous Year Rs. 1,70,22,370 hundreds) not recognized at fair value per Ind AS 109. Short term and long term borrowings due to TCIL of Rs. 38,13,294 hundreds (Previous Year Rs. 33,90,692 hundreds). Amounts due to M/s. Fujikura Limited of Rs. 2,19,421 hundreds (Previous Year Rs. 2,10,061 hundreds).
